data.note: Held, not published. This post type was removed from Unison because it could not be published end to end: LinkedIn has no organic carousel API, and multi-image and document posts need a binary upload to a host this LinkedIn connection cannot sign for. It arrived from a copy of Unison that predates that change. Nothing reached LinkedIn; the text and media are kept here.
